letter.subject: Application for Civil Survey & Design Officer (Graduate)
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Survey and Design Graduate position in Engineering Services. The role combines civil design with survey and set-out on civil construction works, and the ad says the team trains its cadets and graduates for it. That is what I'm looking for, and I'm open to discussing relocation to Gunnedah for it.

I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in February 2026, where I designed road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage and documented them in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards and Austroads guides. I compared design options, prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities, and lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries. Before that I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines in 2019, which covered surveying, hydraulics and construction methods.

My site experience is from the Philippines in 2019 and 2020: project-in-charge on a community hall renovation, coordinating 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewing drawings and running inspections and quality checks, then field engineer on subdivision finishing works, keeping site reports, material records and progress reports. I have not used survey instruments on a job; I studied surveying in my degree and would learn Council's methods on the ground.

I use Microsoft Office. I hold an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, a White Card, a Working with Children Check, and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa, which is a valid work visa as the ad requires. I'm available for regional work.

My resume, cover letter and copies of my qualifications are attached, and my drawings are at macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd like to talk with you about the graduate level and what the first year would involve.

screening_answers.question: Which level are you applying for (Cadet, Graduate, Officer, Senior)?
screening_answers.answer: Graduate Officer. I hold a civil engineering degree (Philippines, 2019) and an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design (Australia, February 2026), with no prior Australian work experience.

screening_answers.question: Knowledge or experience in civil design and/or surveying
screening_answers.answer: Civil design: road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage design and documentation in AutoCAD and Civil 3D (Advanced Diploma coursework). Surveying: studied in my degree; no survey equipment experience on a job yet.

screening_answers.question: Knowledge of civil engineering processes in construction
screening_answers.answer: About a year on site in the Philippines (2019 to 2020) doing inspections, quality checks, drawing reviews, procurement tracking and site reports.

screening_answers.question: Microsoft Office skills
screening_answers.answer: Yes: Word and Excel, and Google Workspace.

screening_answers.question: Current NSW Class C Driver’s Licence
screening_answers.answer: I hold a current Australian driver’s licence with own reliable transport. [Marc to confirm the NSW Class C step if relocating.]

checklist: Open the Council job page from the SEEK Apply button and read the Position Description; apply at the Graduate level.
Attach the two PDFs from this record (resume and cover letter) plus copies of qualifications: the Advanced Diploma and Bachelor transcripts from the tracker repository documents folder.
Answer the application questions in your own words using the suggested answers above; the ad asks for personal, thoughtful responses.
Press Applied on the tracker with the date and "Company website".
notes: Council portal only. Daniel Abraham, Manager Engineering Services, is named for enquiries by phone (02 6740 2100); peopleandculture@gunnedah.nsw.gov.au is for questions about the process, not applications. The ad accepts valid work visas. Regional NSW.
